feeds.title: The OT Toolbox Blog
feeds.description: The OT Toolbox is a site for Therapists, Teachers and Parents. A blog about Occupational Therapy ideas, crafts, handwriting and cursive writing activities, visual perceptual skills, sensory processing. Occupational Therapist sharing creative OT tips and tools for helping therapists, teachers, and parents support their kids and students.

feeds.title: OT Toolkit Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to a blog site devoted to sharing experience, knowledge and resources to make your job of being a great therapist a lot easier. OT's best resource for working with older adults. A 630 page resource manual with 283 patient handouts and 85 treatment guides.

feeds.title: Your Therapy Source Blog
feeds.description: Your Therapy Source is your online resource for special education, pediatric occupational and physical therapy publications. Mission is To provide pediatric therapists, parents and teachers with educational resources.

feeds.title: Your Kids OT Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Cindy and I am an Occupational Therapist. I enjoy working creatively with children to see them reach their potential. Your Kids OT provides paediatric occupational therapy services in Sydney, Australia. An information website and blog for parents, teachers and therapists with creative ways to make learning fun.

feeds.title: My OT Spot Blog
feeds.description: My OT Spot is a resource for occupational therapists and occupational therapy students working in the adult and geriatric populations. Discover occupational therapy and become the best OT you can be. Learn the best kept secrets from professionals in the field.

feeds.title: The Inspired Treehouse Blog
feeds.description: The Inspired Treehouse features child development information from pediatric therapists as well as gross motor, fine motor, and sensory activities designed to promote development through play.

feeds.title: Tools To Grow Blog
feeds.description: Resources & Activities for Pediatric Occupational Therapists, Educators, Special Needs Teachers, Therapists, Parents/Caregivers ... to help children Grow! The mission of Tools to Grow, Inc. is to provide valuable tools to therapists, educators, special needs teachers, and parents/caregivers to help with the most important job there is helping children grow!

feeds.title: PocketOT Blog
feeds.description: Cara Koscinski, MOT, OTR/L is a pediatric Occupational Therapist and mom. She writes books and info. that contain questions frequently asked to pediatric occupational therapists about: -sensory processing -handwriting -core/body muscle weakness -feeding therapy -behavior -life-skills -coordination -transitions -school -IEPs -developmental information and MUCH more!

feeds.title: OT Mom Learning Activities Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with all new pages and changes to the OT Mom Learning Activities website.

feeds.title: Occupational Therapy Helping Children Blog
feeds.description: Occupational Therapy Helping Children is a private practice that operates on Sydney's North Shore and Northern Beaches. It was one of the first Paediatric Private practices set up in Sydney and has been operating continuously since 1994.

feeds.title: Focus Therapy Blog
feeds.description: FOCUS Therapy is a full-service pediatric clinic in Fort Myers offering speech therapy, occupational therapy, physical therapy and behavior therapy.

feeds.title: ABC Therapeutics Occupational Therapy Weblog
feeds.description: Captain of the U.S.S. ABC Therapeutics - private practice near Buffalo, NY. Part time educator and full time stirrer of pots, happily responding to people's needs from deep within the 'darkness of free enterprise.'

feeds.title: Hands on Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Our mission at Hands On Therapy Services is to provide quality therapy for all types of shoulder, elbow, wrist, and hand injuries for all ages. We help people in Miami, FL with arm and hand injuries to be able to be active, pain free, and avoid surgery.

feeds.title: Pediatric Occupational Therapy Tips
feeds.description: I am a pediatric occupational therapist with 24 years experience providing quality OT to children, along with caregiver instruction and support. My mission is to educate and empower therapists, teachers, caregivers, and parents of children with special needs.

feeds.title: The Playful Otter
feeds.description: Children learn through play. As an occupational therapist who works with children and youth, I use games and toys almost every day to help develop important cognitive, visual perceptual, motor, sensory, social, play and leisure skills. While many different types of activities can be used in therapy, this blog focuses on off-the-shelf games and toys that are accessible to most.

feeds.title: Holistic Occupational Therapy Community Blog
feeds.description: The Holistic Occupational Therapy Community serves occupational therapists who are interested in or practice Complementary and Integrative Health, Wellness, and Prevention.

feeds.title: Cutting Edge Pediatric Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Kate and Joe Lundgren are the proud owners of Cutting Edge Pediatric Therapy (CEPT), a occupational therapy clinic which opened in Allen, Texas in June 2013. Although CEPT is a full-service clinic, it specializes in children with special needs, spectrum-related disorders and sensory integration dysfunction.

feeds.title: Learn Play Thrive Blog
feeds.description: I'm Meg Proctor, an occupational therapist, autism specialist, and feeding therapist. I love helping children with autism and other disabilities participate more fully in their lives. But even more, I love helping parents learn some practical, realistic things to try out during their daily routines. Read our blog to find Up-to-date strategies from an occupational therapist and autism specialist to help kids with autism thrive in every day life.

feeds.title: Outdoor Kids Occupational Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Children's occupational therapy services in outdoor nature areas in Berkeley & Oakland. Therapeutic groups designed to build your child's motor skills, sensory processing, social skills, executive functioning, and general well-being through nature play.

feeds.title: The Note Ninjas Blog
feeds.description: A PT and OT resource center promoting skilled care tips, documentation and new treatment ideas for other therapists. The Note Ninjas is dedicated to showing other therapists how to document and provide skilled treatments.

feeds.title: OTDUDE.com
feeds.description: My goal is to provide research-based resources for patients, therapists, new graduates, students, and the general public to advance the field of occupational therapy; improve health outcomes; and enable individuals to have the highest quality of life through engagement of occupations.

feeds.title: Student Platform Occupational Therapy Europe Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Student Platform Occupational Therapy Europe! We have a forum on which you can connect with European Occupational Therapy students. We also try to keep a good amount of news coming your way on our blog!

feeds.title: Better Rehab
feeds.description: Covers NDIS and disability care resources, Good News Stories and team updates! Better Rehab is a leading NDIS registered provider redefining what is possible in the Allied Health space.

feeds.title: The Happy Handwriter Blog
feeds.description: We provide parents, teachers and therapists with effective, kid-friendly fine motor and handwriting resources which enable your children to develop critical skills while having fun along the way!

feeds.title: OT's with Apps
feeds.description: Carol Leynse Harpold, MS, AdEd, OTR/L, ATP with more than 30 years of Occupational Therapy experience in early intervention, school based therapy, acute care, long term care, home health and adult rehabilitation.

feeds.title: Seniors Flourish Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Mandy, an occupational therapist helping OT practitioners working with older adults be the best they can be through education, tips, resources and videos. Helping geriatric OTs & caregivers keep seniors independent through practical independent living tips, education & videos.

feeds.title: Occupationaltherapyblog.com
feeds.description: This blog is for people looking for Occupational Therapy and for those wanting to know more about the role of an Occupational Therapist. Authored by Laila Motty, a Neurological Occupational Therapist and founder of HT Neuro Rehab.

feeds.title: Toddler Development
feeds.description: A mum to two toddlers and a Pediatric Occupational Therapist. Join me in exploring ways to connect, develop and entertain your toddler through play.

feeds.title: MAC&Toys
feeds.description: I am a mom to the amazing 5 1/2 year old Quinn Eloise and wife to the most supportive Rob Reinhardt. I have been a pediatric occupational therapist in New York City since 2001. I have spent the last 13 years as a pediatric occupational therapist in New York City and have loved every second.

feeds.title: CAOT-BC
feeds.description: A Canadian Association of Occupational Therapists- British Columbia.

feeds.title: The Recycling Occupational Therapist
feeds.description: An Occupational Therapy Blog. This Blog is for all who are passionate about Occupational Therapy and is dedicated to promoting & advancing professionals.

feeds.title: OTalk
feeds.description: OTalk is designed to enable discussion about occupational therapy and the broader academic discipline of occupational science. The first OTalk of every month aims to focus on a research theme to support the promotion, use, and conduct of research in the day to day practice of OTs.

feeds.title: 100 Stories of OT Blog
feeds.description: The Occupational Therapy Association of California (OTAC) was incorporated in 1976. In this blog you will find inspirational client* stories on how OT and/or their OT helped them to participate in meaningful activities to optimize their life experience.

feeds.title: OuTcomes Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Regina & Surrounding Area Occupational Therapy. OuTcomes Therapy is a privately owned and operated occupational therapy clinic in Regina serving children, youth and young adults.

feeds.title: Authentic Occupational Therapy® | Blog
feeds.description: We are a company with a mission to bring classical occupational therapy to people in need by facilitating occupational therapy practitioners' creation and development of independent practices that embody authentic occupational therapy ideals.

feeds.title: Vijaya Occupational Therapy Centre (Solutions for life)
feeds.description: Established in 2006, Vijaya Occupational Therapy Centre is a leading outpatient occupational therapy service provider in Chennai, India. Our vision: To uphold the profession of occupational therapy in India and other developing countries through evidence-based service delivery, stakeholder education, training, and research.

feeds.title: Alberta OT Pediatric Interest Group
feeds.description: This blog represents both the Calgary and Edmonton Occupational Therapy Pediatric Interest Groups, which have been meeting for several years! The purpose of the group is to network and share information about professional development, job opportunities and other information relevant to pediatric OT practice.

feeds.title: OT Gives Life
feeds.description: Hello there! I am a graduate of Nova Southeastern University in Davie, Florida with a Master of Occupational Therapy. This website was made in effort to broaden the general public's perspective on the field of Occupational Therapy. Will be posting personal experiences, anecdotes, and ways in which OT shapes others lives as well as my own.

feeds.title: Apex Occupational Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Alicia has worked as an occupational therapist since 2000. I'm enthusiastic about O.T. and enjoy the challenge of creating, researching. and learning new ways to help children and families. I have worked around the country as an O.T. and it has given me great opportunities and experiences.

feeds.title: The Thrive Group Blog
feeds.description: Thrive Occupational Therapy is founded by Miriam Manela, OTR/L, author of The Parent-Child Dance, with the philosophy that each child is unique and treatment must reflect this. In helping build a whole child, a major emphasis is placed on that child's relationships, whether they are the child-therapist, parent-therapist, or parent-child relationship.

feeds.title: MindStart Home Specials
feeds.description: MindStart was founded by occupational therapist Monica Heltemes in 2010. Monica has been working with persons with dementia in various capacities for over 15 years. She has developed an activity program for memory care units and spoken at numerous conferences and training events.

feeds.title: Adapt & Learn Blog
feeds.description: Adapt & Learn, LLC. offers families and educational staff the necessary supports in the areas of occupational therapy and assistive technology. We specialize in educational interventions to ensure that every child is able to maximize his/her learning, regardless of ability level!

feeds.title: CanDo Kiddo + Family
feeds.description: Your source for expert advice from a pediatric Occupational Therapist, a fellow parent, and child development nerd. Blogging, writing and sharing about baby and toddler play, developmental milestones, baby gear, baby and parent wellness, and intentional parenting.

feeds.title: Group by Group
feeds.description: Joy (Occupational Therapist), Cara (Speech Therapist), and Joi (Special Education Teacher) all work at a center based school serving students who have significant intellectual disabilities. Our school also has a pre-k program that serves students both with and without developmental delays.

feeds.title: Speech & OT Blog
feeds.description: Speech & Occupational Therapy of North Texas offers the highest quality speech, language and occupational therapy to the pediatric population in North Texas. We provide our services with a loving, nurturing attitude toward the child and with compassionate, comprehensive support and input for the family.

feeds.title: ABC Pediatric Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Created in 1994, ABC Pediatric Therapy lives it's mission of 'creating the best life for all children' by providing the highest quality of speech, physical, and occupational therapy in a child friendly environment.

feeds.title: Occupational Therapy (OT) Blog and Resource website
feeds.description: Hello, We are Payal and Deepam. We both are Occupational Therapist. We deal with special kids and adults with neuro impairment.. This site can be referred as OT resources for therapists, educators, special needs teachers, and parents/caregivers and other health care professionals.

feeds.title: OT Potential Blog
feeds.description: An occupational therapy blog, written by Sarah Lyon, for occupational therapists, OT students and certified occupational therapy who want to grow their OT career. Topics range from pediatric occupational therapy to geriatrics.

feeds.title: Miss Jaime O.T.
feeds.description: Hi! I am Miss Jaime and I've been a Long Island pediatric OT for seventeen years. I currently work in a public school in Nassau County with students Kindergarten to 5th grade.

feeds.title: Skills On The Hill Blog
feeds.description: At Skills on the Hill, we treat the whole child by considering the environment, the child's strengths and weaknesses, and what is meaningful to the child. We know that the child will do best when he or she is comfortable and motivated, so we disguise everything as play. At our pediatric occupational therapy clinic we address motor delays, visual motor and perceptual deficits.
